gloss: order of numbers; numerical order; in number order

definitions.gloss: order of numbers; numerical order; in number order
definitions.explanation: The arrangement of items, people, or documents according to their assigned number, typically ascending. Used for calling patients at clinics, processing applications, seating students, and organizing files.

examples.japanese: {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{呼|よ}び→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will call you in order of your reception number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べて→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{綴|と}じた→綴じる：19583_tojiru⟧。
examples.english: I arranged the documents in number order and put them into a file.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えて→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦もらいます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'll have you answer in order of attendance number, so please listen carefully to the previous person's answer as well.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧ (number) + ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ (order, sequence). A highly practical everyday word used wherever numbered tickets, IDs, or slots are involved.

USAGE:
- Frequently heard at hospitals, banks, city offices, and restaurants where numbered tickets or reservations are used.
- Commonly appears with ⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ (to line up), ⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call), ⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧ (to arrange), and ⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧ (to process).
- In Japanese schools, students are often assigned an ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧ (attendance number), and teachers may call on them in {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in number order
- {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{呼|よ}び→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to call (people) in number order
- {番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to process in number order
- ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}: in order of attendance number
- ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧{番号|ばんごう}{順|じゅん}: in order of reception number

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{五十音|ごじゅうおん}→五十音：15489_gojuuon⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧: Japanese syllabary order — the traditional way of sorting Japanese names and words
- ⟦アルファベット→アルファベット：10709_arufabetto⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧: alphabetical order
- ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧: order of arrival
- ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧: order of reception (first come, first served)
- ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧: order by age
